sources.title: Octen-Embedding-8B: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview Octen-Embedding-8B is a 7.6B parameter text embedding model fine-tuned from Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-8B that ranks first on the RTEB Leaderboard (Mean Task score of 0.8045) as of January 12, 2026. Built by Octen, this model produces 4096-dimensional embeddings and supports up to 32,768 tokens of context, making it suitable for semantic search, document retrieval, and question answering ...
